title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode5 Cherish The Time Left

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: A few days later
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, Minori, you and Haruka are ready to switch to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I wasn't really sure at first...
But after giving it a lot of thought, I made a decision that I feel happy with!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's wonderful to hear.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: When you and I talked, you said schoolwork might be a challenge... Does this mean you know what you're gonna do about that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... Not exactly since I won't know how a lot of things go until I actually give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I've just gotta do the best I can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, Airi, Shizuku, I can always ask you two if I have any questions since you've both been in it for so long now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Ask us whenever you like♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be more than happy to help if we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us will probably be studying together during our time off, which I'm actually sort of looking forward to...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, me too!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, then!
We can stream that! What do you think?! We can call it something like “Let's Study with MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'd rather not. It'd be way too hard to focus.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. In any case, it's nice to hear that you're all looking forward to being in the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
By the way, when do you plan on making the switch...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really soon!
I asked my teacher about it and was told that there are two opportunities per year to switch. Once in spring and once in the fall.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which works out really well since we're all about to move up a year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
Oh, that means you get to be regular students until you begin your second year!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, but it's still happening pretty soon.
That's why I want to treasure the time I have left.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't wanna find myself looking back after making the switch and saying, “No, I should've done that back then!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's understandable...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay, you two!
That means you really gotta have fun during the time you have left as regular high schoolers!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks, we will!
The next day
Hanasato Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, I'm gonna get going now!!!

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: Bye. Have fun at school.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Bye...
Hmm... Is it just me, or did she sound more excited than usual?

rows.Speaker: Minori's Mother
rows.Line: She did say something about trying to enjoy the time she has left as a regular high school student.

rows.Speaker: Minori's Brother
rows.Line:
Uh, okay...?
I guess that makes sense...?
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, this breeze feels so nice!
And my usual walk to school feels so different when I look at it in a new way!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh!
This flower is finally blooming!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hehe. I was wondering when it would after seeing it budding just the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have a really good feeling about today.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Good morning, Minori.
You seem really happy today. Even more than usual.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Morning, you two!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You gotta see this!
I found this flower the other day, and now it's finally blooming!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
It's growing out of the asphalt too. It must be pretty hardy.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It's so pretty!
I hope the crows don't decide to pick it apart or anything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, that'd be awful!
And way too soon! It just started blooming today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad we got to see it today.
There's actually another one budding just up ahead!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Once it blooms, we can see it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I get to see these flowers with Shiho and Kohane because we go to school at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But after I go credit-based...)

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: Hey, did you guys see that sweets special yesterday?! The cafe they showed is apparently really close by.

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line: I heard an old alumnus is coming to visit our club today! I hope they're not too hard on us this time...

rows.Speaker: Miya Girls Students
rows.Line:
No, I totally forgot about that assignment!
Can you show me what you did?! Please, I'll never ask for anything again...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Everyone chatting with each other while we all head to school... I won't get to see that as much moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I never really thought of things this way before. It was all just “normal”...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The little things in life that happen every day. I guess I took it all for granted until now.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Then, I've gotta do my best to see everything else I've been taking for granted.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (That way, after I do go credit-based, I'll be able to look back fondly on all the fun stuff I did!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Minori Hanasato is still a regular high schooler! And she's gonna make the final sprint to reach the next chapter of her life! “Part 2: Full-Time Idol!”

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Minori sounds really excited.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Yes, she does. Still...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I wasn't expecting you to suggest seeing what her school's like, Len.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Me neither...
What made you want to do this all of a sudden?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <It wasn't as sudden as you think. I began wondering after Airi told us her story the other day.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I wasn't able to give her any useful advice then since I didn't really know anything about what it's like to go to school or be a student. It wasn't a good feeling...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I wanna learn more about their school.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That makes sense...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <They ended up figuring everything out all on their own before I could do anything...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But school means a lot to them, so I wanna know what it's like to be a student.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Right...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <They always enjoy talking about things that happen at school and their friends there, but we've never actually seen that for ourselves...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Learning about their school life could very well help us give them better advice if anything else comes up in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <True...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Then, let's go see what Minori is like as a student and what her school is like!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. We'll need to make sure she doesn't see us.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm not sure how I feel about us sneaking around like this... But I wouldn't want to ruin what precious little time she has left with her friends.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Me neither. I wouldn't want to say something and make Minori concern herself with us.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <So, everyone, shush! We gotta keep our voices down!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <You're the one I'm most worried about, Rin...>
